## Our Mission

::: {.mission-cols}

::: {.mission-col}
### Science

We contribute to understanding the Arctic as a system component by bridging
disciplines and methodological approaches, sharing results and data through
open science, and teaching across disciplines.

::: {.link-row}
[Science networks]{.link-row-label}
[HiLDEN []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://arcticdrones.org){.link-item title="HiLDEN"}
[AVA []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://iasc.info/our-work/working-groups/terrestrial/twg-projects/817-an-arctic-vegetation-archive-ava){.link-item title="Arctic Vegetation Archive"}
[EU-Charter []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.charter-arctic.org){.link-item title="EU-Charter"}
[Geoengineering []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://iasc.info/our-work/working-groups/cross-cutting-activities/cross-cutting-funded-projects/1129-geoengineering-to-save-the-arctic-assessing-potential-efficacy-impacts-and-ethical-considerations-across-rightholders-stakeholders-and-scientific-disciplines){.link-item title="Geoengineering to save the Arctic?"}
:::
:::

::: {.mission-col}
### Society

We aim to address societal challenges at the nexus of climate and
biodiversity, and to inform society through webinars, panel discussions and
newspaper articles.

::: {.link-row}
[In the media]{.link-row-label}
[UZH News []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.news.uzh.ch/en/articles/media/2024/Arctic.html){.link-item title="Rapidly Increasing Industrial Activities in the Arctic"}

[SRF Tagesschau []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.srf.ch/play/tv/tagesschau/video/tagesschau-vom-20-11-2022-hauptausgabe?urn=urn%3Asrf%3Avideo%3A4c86acab-cb58-48f5-a5f4-a63f1935091f){.link-item title="Interview Prof. Dr. Gabriela Schaepman-Strub for SRF Tagesschau"}
[swissinfo: Arctic research []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/russia-ukraine-war-threatens-crucial-arctic-research/47533972){.link-item title="War in Ukraine threatens crucial Arctic research"}
[swissinfo: biodiversity []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/will-the-new-biodiversity-framework-help-us-live-in-harmony-with-nature-/48148250){.link-item title="Will the new biodiversity framework help us live in harmony with nature?"}

::: {.mission-col}
### Policy

We contribute to international science-policy platforms, Arctic
organisations and conventions on biodiversity.

::: {.link-row}
[Bodies]{.link-row-label}

[IASC []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://iasc.info){.link-item title="International Arctic Science Committee"}
[CAFF []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.caff.is){.link-item title="Conservation of Arctic Flora and Fauna"}
[CBD []{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.cbd.int){.link-item title="Convention on Biological Diversity"}
